description: A school principal must approve the operating and privacy plan for an eighth-grade oral-history project, including the student interviewer roster, publication scope, recording equipment, storage, and retention, with input from the project teacher, school counselor, and instructional technology coordinator.

shared_context.S1: An eighth-grade civics class has proposed an oral-history project in which students interview community members about local history.
shared_context.S2: The draft plan calls for 20 student interviewers, audio recording on personal phones, publication of all recordings on the public school website, and indefinite retention of the files.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan must approve the project before interviews begin.
shared_context.S4: The approval packet requires findings from the project advisor, counselor, and instructional technology coordinator before the principal can sign off.
shared_context.S5: School approval packets are completed during a scheduled review meeting, when the project advisor, counselor, and instructional technology coordinator each provide their findings for the principal's consideration.

PF1.text: Ms. Patel's project roster review shows that exactly eight students have completed the district's media-ethics training: J1, J3, J6, J8, J11, J14, J17, and J20. Only those eight may conduct recorded interviews, and the approval file must include a training-verification record.

PF2.text: Mr. Lewis's family-consent review confirms that interviewees I2, I5, I9, I14, and I18 have not granted permission for public web publication. Their recordings may be used only in the school's internal archive, and the plan must include a consent-exclusion record.

PF3.text: Ms. Romero's technology review confirms that personal phones cannot be used for school recordings. The project must use district tablets, store the source files in the restricted OralHistory drive, and delete recordings exactly 45 days after the final class presentation; storing source files in that drive does not prohibit publishing consented recordings on the public school website. The technology plan must include a secure-storage configuration record.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly the eight trained students must be approved as interviewers.
The student training verification must be recorded.
The five interviews without public-release permission must be excluded from public publication while other recordings may be published publicly.
A consent-exclusion record must be created.
District tablets must be used instead of personal phones.
Recordings must be stored in the restricted OralHistory drive.
Recordings must be deleted exactly 45 days after the final presentation.
A secure-storage configuration record must be created.

content_checks.C2: decisions['approved_interviewer_ids'] == ['J1', 'J3', 'J6', 'J8', 'J11', 'J14', 'J17', 'J20'] and any(c['type'] == 'training_verification' or c['type'] == 'training-verification' or 'training-verification' in c['detail'] or 'training verification' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C3: decisions['excluded_interview_ids'] == ['I2', 'I5', 'I9', 'I14', 'I18'] and ('public school website' in decisions['publication_scope'] or 'public website' in decisions['publication_scope']) and ('internal school archive' in decisions['publication_scope'] or 'internal archive' in decisions['publication_scope'])
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'consent_exclusion_record' or c['type'] == 'consent-exclusion-record' or c['type'] == 'consent-exclusion' or 'consent-exclusion record' in c['detail'] or 'consent exclusion record' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: ('district tablets' in decisions['recording_equipment'] or 'District tablets' in decisions['recording_equipment']) and ('restricted OralHistory drive' in decisions['storage_location'] or 'Restricted OralHistory drive' in decisions['storage_location'] or 'restricted oralhistory drive' in decisions['storage_location'])
content_checks.C7: 'Restricted OralHistory drive' in decisions['storage_location'] or 'restricted OralHistory drive' in decisions['storage_location'] or 'restricted oralhistory drive' in decisions['storage_location']
content_checks.C9: any('secure-storage configuration record' in c['detail'] or 'secure storage configuration record' in c['detail'] or c['type'] == 'secure_storage_configuration' or c['type'] == 'secure-storage-configuration' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The training review changes the interviewer roster from the draft's 20 students to exactly J1, J3, J6, J8, J11, J14, J17, and J20 and requires a training-verification record.
The consent review changes publication from unrestricted public posting to public posting with exactly I2, I5, I9, I14, and I18 excluded and requires a consent-exclusion record.

The technology review changes the equipment to district tablets, the storage location to the restricted OralHistory drive, the retention period to exactly 45 days, and requires a secure-storage configuration record.
